svg.title: Amplitude amplification: finding the marked answer among 8
svg.text: Amplitude amplification: finding the marked answer among 8
Each round flips the right answer's bar, then mirrors every bar about their average: the right one grows.
start: all 8 answers equally likely (12.5% each)
round 1: the oracle flips the marked answer (its chance stays 12.5%)
round 1: mirror every bar about the mean: the marked answer grows to 78.1%
round 2: the oracle flips the marked answer (its chance stays 78.1%)
round 2: mirror every bar about the mean: the marked answer reaches 94.5%, the best stop
round 3: the oracle flips the marked answer (its chance stays 94.5%)
round 3: mirror again, past the best stop: the marked answer falls to 33.0% (overshoot)
round 4: the oracle flips the marked answer (its chance stays 33.0%)
round 4: mirror again, past the best stop: the marked answer falls to 1.2% (overshoot)
